subsystems.name: Sensing nodes
subsystems.role: the sensing skin itself — enormous numbers of tiny, self-powered units measuring temperature, pressure, motion, chemistry or magnetism.
parts: microcontroller and radio or optical transceiver

subsystems.name: Backhaul constellation
subsystems.role: carries readings from anywhere on Earth to data centres without ground infrastructure.
parts: low-Earth-orbit satellites with optical inter-satellite links

subsystems.name: Quantum-secure link layer
subsystems.role: makes the network's keys tamper-evident, so readings and commands cannot be silently altered.

subsystems.name: Localisation and timing
subsystems.role: every reading needs a place and a time or it is useless.

subsystems.name: Edge compute and fusion
subsystems.role: turns raw counts into usable state estimates without shipping everything to a data centre.

subsystems.name: Deployment and maintenance
subsystems.role: gets millions to billions of nodes into position and replaces the ones that fail.

buildSteps.title: Decide what to measure
buildSteps.detail: Choose physical quantities, spatial density, accuracy and update rate for each region, since these set size, power and cost per node.

buildSteps.title: Design the node chipset
buildSteps.detail: Integrate sensing elements, a low-power processor, memory, timing and a radio onto as few silicon dies as possible, targeting millimetre-scale packages.

buildSteps.title: Solve the power budget
buildSteps.detail: Harvest from vibration, temperature gradients, light or radio waves and store in a thin-film battery or supercapacitor, because a node must survive years untended.

buildSteps.title: Mass-produce nodes
buildSteps.detail: Use semiconductor wafer fabs and roll-to-roll printing so unit cost falls to cents, which is what makes planetary numbers affordable.

buildSteps.title: Build the backhaul
buildSteps.detail: Launch a satellite constellation with laser cross-links and simple ground terminals so nodes only need short-range, low-power radios.

buildSteps.title: Layer in quantum-secure keys
buildSteps.detail: Add QKD terminals at aggregation points and, where needed, quantum repeaters to extend entanglement or key distribution over long distances.

buildSteps.title: Distribute the nodes
buildSteps.detail: Scatter them from aircraft and drones, embed them in roads, buildings and farm soil, and drift them across oceans as floating sensors.

buildSteps.title: Bring the mesh online
buildSteps.detail: Nodes discover neighbours, synchronise clocks, resolve their positions by ranging and route data around failures.

buildSteps.title: Fuse and use the data
buildSteps.detail: Calibrate against reference instruments, run large-scale physics models, and issue warnings or feed control systems.

prerequisites.why: millimetre-scale nodes that run for years on harvested energy have been demonstrated in labs but not at planetary numbers.
constellations in low Earth orbit already provide global backhaul, though not yet cheap enough for trillions of endpoints.
temperature, pressure, acceleration and magnetic sensing are easily miniaturised; chemical and biological sensing is not.
key distribution works over fibre and satellite links today, but extending quantum links across a planet needs repeaters that remain laboratory demonstrations.
ingesting and calibrating billions of independent streams is a computing and standards problem that is only partly solved.

pathway.milestone: regional dense networks: seismic arrays, air-quality monitors, ocean buoys and radar satellites such as InSAR imagers
pathway.unlocks: proof that wide-area, continuous sensing produces useful forecasts and early warnings.

pathway.milestone: city- and catchment-scale self-powered wireless mesh demonstrations
pathway.unlocks: experience with millions, not thousands, of nodes: addressing, power, calibration and repair.

pathway.milestone: global backhaul with optical-linked satellite constellations and open data standards
pathway.unlocks: sensing in oceans, deserts and polar regions where no ground network exists.

pathway.milestone: quantum-secure links between aggregation nodes via working repeaters
pathway.unlocks: trustworthy readings for critical systems such as disaster warning and infrastructure control.

pathway.milestone: a continuously updated planetary digital twin
pathway.unlocks: better prediction and management of climate, hazards and resources — monitoring rather than any attempt to steer the climate directly.
